title: Plain simulation of oracle computations
statement: Let $M$ be a finite oracle Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $D$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $O$ be a language of binary strings, and let $\tau:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ be nondecreasing. Suppose $D$ decides $O$ within time $\tau$. Then there are a finite Turing machine $P$ over the binary alphabet and a natural number $a$ such that, for every binary input $x$, output word $y$, and time $t$, if $M$ with oracle $O$ halts on its initial configuration on $x$ after $t$ steps with output $y$, then $P$ computes $y$ from $x$ within $a(t+1)(t+1+\tau(t))$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite oracle Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$D$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$O$ is a language of binary strings
